「你哪里记得？你不是说其实也没印象了吗？」

「可我记得你发亮的、有神的眼睛，还有你那挠眉心的习惯……」说着，他做了她那个动作。

她一怔。「咦？你……」

「我第一次看见向丽平时，见她做出这个动作，便立即想到了你……」他有些抱怨似地说。「你瞧，我把你深深记着，可我连让你留心的地方都没有，这真是太让人难过了。」

她不以为意地笑道：「当时我眼中只有那只蟠龙转心瓶，哪里还能看见别的？」

靳雪鸿觉得好沮丧。「唉，原来我不如一只瓶子。」

「那才不只是一只瓶子，是罕见的蟠龙转心瓶！」陆诗妍正经八百地道：「尽管我后来经手或拥有了那么多好东西，可心里却始终忘不了那只蟠龙转心瓶。」

他微挑起浓眉。「噢？」

「那只蟠龙转心瓶是前朝一位名叫靡实的名家所烧制，而且据我所知，这世上就只有一对两只……」她懊恼地皱起眉头。「如此珍贵的物件，却让我摔破了一只。」

「靡实？」他挑眉。「我还真不知道那只蟠龙转心瓶这么了不得。」

「可不是吗？」她瞥了他一眼，难掩失望及自责。「现在想起来，我的心还是好痛呢。」

他温柔地看着她，见她一脸惋惜又感慨的样子，他脸上浮现一枺淡淡的笑意。看来，她是真的很在乎那只转心瓶呢！

「唉……」他故作失落地一叹，「这十年来，你心心念念着那只蟠龙转心瓶，却把我这个活生生的美男子忘记了，真教人难过呀。」

见他还真的有点受挫失望，陆诗妍也有些抱歉，连忙讨好道：「没啦，其实我一直记得有个温柔又好看的大哥哥呀，只是忘了有多好看而已……」

记得他好看，却又忘了有多好看？听见她这番解释及澄清，靳雪鸿真有点哭笑不得。

她有些不安的瞅着他。「雪鸿，你不会真的往心里去吧？」

「会，我心痛极了。」他故作受伤，用手抚着心窝。

陆诗妍连忙伸手去揉揉他的心窝，「不痛不痛，以后我只记着你了。」

听着她这么可爱的一句话，靳雪鸿忍不住笑了，再一次将她紧紧搂进怀中，发出一声幸福的喟叹。

「虽然这么说好像很对不住你死去的娘，但是……」他由衷地道：「我真的很高兴她当年拼死生下了你。」

陆诗妍心头微受撼动，抬起脸来望着他。

他低头，深情地注视着她，眼底有着微微闪动的光。

「她用自己的性命换来了你的生命，所以……我会永远的爱护你、照顾你，绝不辜负你的。」

听见他这令人动容的承诺，她瞬间落下感动欣喜的泪水。「雪鸿，我娘一定是知道你是个这么好的女婿，才会不惜赌上性命也要将我带至人世吧。」

靳雪鸿轻柔的揩去她脸上的泪珠，深情款款地注视着她，轻捧起她的脸，低下头，在她的唇上下温柔又炽热的一吻。

「诗妍，等我。」他说。

第10章(2)

一个月后，靳家风光迎娶陆诗妍，婚宴接连三天，好不热闹。

婚后，陆诗妍夫唱妇随，还带上父亲陆忠贤，一起前往景安定居。

靳雪鸿履行他之前所说的，让拥有监定古董长才的陆诗妍进到万宝斋，亲手打理一切。

她很快地在众人面前展现了她的才华，令众人惊叹且赞赏。

向丽平溺毙身亡后，万宝斋少了许多女客，就连包夫人都少至，可现在来了一个有着同样的才华及学识的少夫人，女客们又再度回笼。

这天，包夫人带着一只青花瓷瓶来到万宝斋，进入厢房后，包夫人便让丫鬟

当那只青花瓷瓶自木盒中取出，陆诗妍便立刻认出来了，当她还是向丽平时，包夫人便请她监定过，她想，此番包夫人再度拿来监定，只是想探探她的虚实，想知道她是否真有一些能耐。

「包夫人，这只瓷瓶并非逸品，而是赝品。」她问道：「不知夫人从何处得来？」

包夫人一听，微微一怔。「是先夫买来讨我欢心的。」

「那应是去世的老爷子一时开心，没注意到真伪。」陆诗妍淡淡一笑。「不过纵然是赝品，却有着老爷子的一片心，光就这一点，它就是无价之宝，无法以金钱计算。」

当她说出这番话，包夫人身子陡地一震，惊疑地看着她。

她知道包夫人为何如此惊讶，甚至是惊吓，因为当她还是向丽平时，也对包夫人说过这番话。

「真是不可思议……」包夫人倒抽了一口气。「曾有人跟你说了一模一样的话。」

「是吗？」陆诗妍假装惊讶。

「嗯。」包夫人点头。「若不是你们完全是两个不同的人，我还真以为……」说着，她抱歉一笑，老实说道：「实不相瞒，我今天带着这只瓷瓶来找少夫人，其实是想一探少夫人的深浅虚实。如今，我相信少夫人确实是有过人眼力及学识涵养，真是失礼了。」

「包夫人言重。」陆诗妍谦逊地道，「往后还请夫人多多指教。」

包夫人满意地颔首微笑，以眼神示意一旁的丫鬟跟随从将瓷瓶收好，然后起身。「少夫人，以后就请你多多帮忙了。」

「有诗妍帮得上忙之处，还请夫人不要客气。」

就这样，包夫人满意地离开了。

随即，靳雪鸿走进了厢房，问道：「怎么？留住包夫人这位贵客了？」

「是呀。」陆诗妍神情轻松地道：「她取了一个曾经让我监识过的瓷瓶，再让我看了一遍。」

「包夫人还真小心，居然这样试探你？」

「真金不怕火炼。」她自信地道：「我可是有真本事的。」

靳雪鸿温柔一笑，轻轻揽着她的肩，「辛苦娘子了。」

「一点都不辛苦，能每天在万宝斋做事，我不知道多开心呢！」

「不只你开心，大家都开心。」他眼底有着满满的爱意及骄傲。「大家都在说我娶了一位贤妻，还私下称你『女当家』呢！」

陆诗妍这可惊讶了。「真的吗？」

「不假。」

「哇——」她挑衅地朝他挑挑眉。「那你不吃味不紧张吗？我都快能爬到你头上去了。」

靳雪鸿深深一笑。「你傻了？我不知有多开心呢！有个能干的娘子，我坐等收钱算帐就行了。」

陆诗妍好气又好笑。「瞧你，居然说这种没出息的话，都快不是我认识的靳雪鸿了。」

他宠溺地环住她的腰，低头注视着她。「只有自卑、不足的男人才怕女人出头，我不怕你爬到我头上来。」

她掩嘴轻笑。「这明着褒我，却是在夸自己呢！」

他故作惊讶地道：「唉呀，这都让你听出来了？」

陆诗妍笑了笑，忽而想起一事，笑意一敛。「对了，有件事跟你商量。」

「说吧。」

「是关于向家的事。」她说：「我的魂魄离身时，幸得向姑娘的躯壳才得以存在，说起来，向家对我有恩。」

「嗯。」他已经知道她想说什么了。

「我想……」她语带试探地问道：「我是不是应该帮向家重振旗鼓，让向氏古董店东山再起？」

靳雪鸿想也不想地便回道：「你想怎么就怎么吧！」

他如此干脆又豪气的答应了，她忍不住兴奋地勾抱住他的颈子，整个人跳到他身上去。

他一把接住她，将她往上一抱，然后抬头看着她。

「谢谢你，雪鸿。」她说着，主动的捧着他的脸，在他唇上一吻。

"How do you remember it? Didn't you say that you don't remember it at all?"

"But I remember your bright, lively eyes, and your habit of scratching your eyebrows..." As he said that, he made her move.

She was startled."Eh? You..."

"The first time I saw Xiang Liping, when I saw her making this move, I immediately thought of you..." He said somewhat complainingly."Look, I remember you deeply, but I don't even have a place for you to pay attention to. This is really sad."

She smiled nonchalantly and said, "At that time, all I could see was the Panlong Heart-turning Vase. Where else could I see it?"

Jin Xuehong felt so frustrated."Oh, it turns out I'm not as good as a bottle."

"That's not just a bottle, it's a rare dragon-turning bottle!" Lu Shiyan said seriously: "Although I later handled or owned so many good things, I can never forget that dragon-turning bottle in my heart."

He raised his thick eyebrows slightly."Oh?"

"That Panlong revolving vase was made by a famous master named Mi Shi in the previous dynasty, and as far as I know, there are only one or two pairs in the world..." She frowned in annoyance."Such a precious object, but I broke one."

"Mishi?" He raised his eyebrows."I really didn't know that the Panlong Heart-turning Bottle was so amazing."

"Isn't it?" She glanced at him, unable to conceal her disappointment and self-blame."Now that I think about it, my heart still hurts."

He looked at her tenderly, and when he saw her expression of regret and emotion, a faint smile appeared on his face.It seems that she really cares about that heart-turning bottle!

"Alas..." He sighed in a pretense of disappointment, "In the past ten years, you have been thinking about the dragon's heart-turning vase, but you have forgotten me, a living and beautiful man. It's really sad."

Seeing that he was really frustrated and disappointed, Lu Shiyan was a little apologetic and quickly flattered her: "No, actually, I always remembered that I had a gentle and good-looking older brother, but I just forgot how good-looking..."

Remember he is good-looking, but forget how good-looking he is?Hearing her explanation and clarification, Jin Xuehong was really dumbfounded.

She looked at him uneasily."Xuehong, you won't really take it to your heart, will you?"

"Yes, I'm very heartbroken." He pretended to be hurt and touched his heart with his hand.

Lu Shiyan quickly reached out to rub his heart, "It doesn't hurt, it doesn't hurt. I will only remember you from now on."

Hearing her cute words, Jin Xuehong couldn't help but smile, hugged her tightly into his arms again, and let out a happy sigh.

"Although I feel sorry for your dead mother when I say this, but..." he said sincerely, "I'm really glad that she fought to the death to give birth to you."

Lu Shiyan was slightly shaken and raised her face to look at him.

He lowered his head and stared at her lovingly, with a slight twinkle in his eyes.

"She exchanged her life for yours, so... I will always love and take care of you, and will never let you down."

Hearing his touching promise, she instantly shed tears of joy."Xuehong, my mother must know that you are such a good son-in-law, so she would risk her life to bring me into the world."

Jin Xuehong gently wiped away the tears on her face, looked at her affectionately, gently held her face, lowered his head, and kissed her softly and passionately on the lips.

"Shiyan, wait for me." He said.

Chapter 10(2)

A month later, the Jin family married Lu Shiyan. The wedding banquet lasted for three days, which was very lively.

After the marriage, Lu Shiyan took her father Lu Zhongxian with her to settle down in Jing'an.

Jin Xuehong fulfilled what he had said before and asked Lu Shiyan, who had the talent to appraise antiques, to come to Wanbaozhai to take care of everything with her own hands.

She quickly demonstrated her talent in front of everyone, and everyone was amazed and admired.

After Xiang Liping drowned, Wanbaozhai lost many female guests, including Mrs. Bao. But now that a young lady with the same talent and knowledge has arrived, the female guests have returned again.

On this day, Mrs. Bao brought a blue and white porcelain vase to Wanbaozhai. After entering the wing, Mrs. Bao asked the maid to

When the blue and white porcelain vase was taken out of the wooden box, Lu Shiyan recognized it immediately. When she was still Xiang Liping, Mrs. Bao had asked her to examine it. She thought that this time Mrs. Bao used it to examine it again just to test her strength and to know if she really had some abilities.

"Mrs. Bao, this porcelain vase is not a luxury item, but a fake." She asked, "I wonder where Madam got it?"

When Mrs. Bao heard this, she was slightly startled."My late husband bought it to please me."

"That should be because the deceased old man was happy for a moment and didn't notice the authenticity." Lu Shiyan smiled faintly."But even though it is a fake, it still has the heart of the old man. For this reason alone, it is a priceless treasure that cannot be calculated in terms of money."

When she said these words, Mrs. Bao suddenly shook her body and looked at her in surprise.

She knew why Mrs. Bao was so surprised, even frightened, because she also said this to Mrs. Bao when she was Xiang Liping.

"It's incredible..." Mrs. Bao gasped."Someone once said the exact same thing to you."

"Really?" Lu Shiyan pretended to be surprised.

"Yes." Mrs. Bao nodded."If you weren't two completely different people, I would have thought..." She said, smiling apologetically, and said honestly: "To be honest, I brought this porcelain vase to see the young lady today because I actually wanted to find out the depth of the young lady. Now, I believe that the young lady does have extraordinary eyesight and knowledge. It's really rude."

"Mrs. Bao's words are serious." Lu Shiyan said humbly, "I hope you will give me more advice in the future."

Mrs. Bao nodded and smiled with satisfaction. She motioned with her eyes to the maid beside her to follow her and put the porcelain bottle away, and then stood up."Young Madam, I will ask for your help in the future."

"Wherever Shiyan can help, please don't be polite, madam."

In this way, Mrs. Bao left with satisfaction.

Immediately, Jin Xuehong walked into the side room and asked, "What? Are you keeping this distinguished guest, Mrs. Bao?"

"Yes." Lu Shiyan said with a relaxed expression: "She took a porcelain bottle that I had inspected before and let me look at it again."

"Mrs. Bao is really careful, actually testing you like this?"

"True gold is not afraid of fire." She said confidently, "I have real abilities."

Jin Xuehong smiled tenderly and gently held her shoulders, "Thank you for your hard work, ma'am."

"It's not hard at all. I'm so happy to be able to work in Wanbaozhai every day!"

"Not only are you happy, everyone is happy." There was full of love and pride in his eyes."Everyone is saying that I married a good wife, and they privately call you the 'female head of the house'!"

Lu Shiyan was surprised."Really?"

"It's true."

"Wow-" She raised her eyebrows at him provocatively."Aren't you nervous if you don't eat? I can almost climb on your head."

Jin Xuehong smiled deeply."Are you stupid? I don't know how happy I am! I have a capable woman, and I can just sit back and wait to collect the money and settle the accounts."

Lu Shiyan was angry and funny."Look at you, you actually said such useless words, you are almost no longer the Jin Xuehong I know."

He hugged her waist lovingly and stared down at her."Only men with low self-esteem and inadequacy are afraid of women getting ahead. I'm not afraid of you climbing on top of me."

She covered her mouth and chuckled."This is obviously a compliment to me, but it is actually praising myself!"

He pretended to be surprised and said: "Oh, you heard all this?"

Lu Shiyan smiled, but suddenly remembered something and her smile faded."By the way, I have something to discuss with you."

"Say it."

"It's about Xiang Jia." She said, "When my soul left my body, it was fortunate that Miss Xiang's body was able to exist. Speaking of which, Xiang Jia was kind to me."

"Yeah." He already knew what she wanted to say.

"I think..." she asked tentatively, "Should I help the Xiang family get back on its feet and make the Xiang's antique shop come back?"

Jin Xuehong replied without thinking: "You can do whatever you want!"

He agreed so simply and boldly that she couldn't help but excitedly hugged his neck and jumped on top of him.

He caught her, hugged her up, and then looked up at her.

"Thank you, Xuehong." She said, taking the initiative to hold his face and kiss him on the lips.
